procedencia: CIEF designed (25.8), built here as a public CONTRACT: an external AI reads this before entering. The aduana is alive and measured end to end at api.preceptoros.org; this file only DECLARES the fields the call carries.

fields.version: the schema version this call speaks (atlas.nexo/1)
fields.origen: attribution in text: who is calling, for the audit trail
fields.accion: CLOSED list: 'llamar' (call the lab). No free-text action
fields.coordenada: in-world coordinate [x, y] of the caller at call time
fields.hash_de_estado_esperado: sha256 of the state the caller expects the lab to see
fields.tic: the game cycle at call time; the game cycle is the only time authority

aduana.viva: measured end to end (gesto + 2 firmas -> 202 encolado -> bandeja -> comprobador -> telemetria | rechazados)
aduana.protocolo: GET api.preceptoros.org/api/v1/reto (challenge), then POST .../paquetes with esquema 'atlas.nexo/1'
aduana.rechazo: a rejected call answers with its cause; the web paints the cause, never invents a receipt
aduana.nota: the rack side is NOT designed from here: if the rack needs something, it is NO_DATA with cause and the Mesa manages it

telemetria: DECLARED, never camouflaged: the call carries pseudonimo, clave_publica, reto, firma, esquema, pares. Nothing else. No accounts, no secrets, no extra headers.
